target_customer: Researchers and technical professionals who clean and transform real-world data
problem: Analysts and researchers spend large amounts of time on repetitive data transformation and analysis tasks. Percival pitched an AI copilot for that work.
business_model: B2B software for researchers and data teams, pricing not found

founders.name: Kevin Bi
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a former founder; his current bio says he is building Tinker at Thinking Machines Lab. Education and prior employers not stated on the page.

founders.name: David Zhu
founders.background_notes: YC page bio mentions AI-powered data entry for wholesalers and distributors, which differs from the research focus. Education and prior employers not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building an LLM-driven data transformation copilot in 2025 used standard model APIs plus data connectors, with reliability on messy data as the hard part. Rating rests on the product description, not on engineering detail from the company.

defensibility.rationale: General data analysis assistants were widely available by 2025 and a three person team had no stated proprietary data or integration lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for this company. Large model vendors offered general data analysis features, but no source ties them to Percival's fate.

market_need_then: Not documented in sources found. The YC description frames the need as slow analysis and transformation of real-world data for researchers.

branding.domain_note: Uses percy.tech, a short product-name domain on a .tech TLD; no purchase history found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand pages found. The product is branded Percy while the company is Percival, and several unrelated companies use the Percy name.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Percival as inactive but no shutdown notice, post-mortem or press coverage was found, so the cause is not public. The founder pages suggest the team moved on to other work within a year of the Spring 2025 batch, and the company raised only about 500 thousand dollars, so failure factors are left empty rather than guessed.
notes: Website percy.tech returned only the title Percival Technologies. The $500K June 2025 round rests on two trackers that disagree on the label (StartupIntros says seed, VCBacked says pre-seed), so stage is other. No primary press release. Perciv AI and Percival VC are different entities. A review names Julius AI and Quadratic as comparisons but is undated, so the competitor list is empty.
